rows.jyutping: jung6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 ge3 jyu5 hei3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone speaks in a belittling or disparaging way.

example.english: They spoke deprecatingly: “You can’t even manage something this simple—you’re really useless.”
example.traditional: 佢用睇唔起人嘅語氣話：「咁簡單都做唔掂，你真係冇用。」
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 ge3 jyu5 hei3 waa6 gam3 gaan2 daan1 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6 nei5 zan1 hai6 mou5 jung6

rows.note: Use this when the speaker is specifically making fun of or putting down themself.

example.english: I said deprecatingly, joking at my own expense, “I’m all grown up, but I can’t even cook noodles without burning them.”
example.traditional: 我自嘲咁話：「我咁大個人，連煮個麵都煮燶。」
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi6 zaau1 gam3 waa6 ngo5 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4 lin4 zyu2 go3 min6 dou1 zyu2 nung1
